name: invoice-fraud-detection-system
description: Indian Invoice Fraud Detection System - Enterprise Rule-Based Audit Web Application

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm.cmd run dev --prefix server" "npm.cmd run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm.cmd run build --prefix server && npm.cmd run build --prefix client
scripts.typecheck: npm.cmd run typecheck --prefix server && npm.cmd run typecheck --prefix client
scripts.install:all: npm.cmd install && npm.cmd install --prefix server && npm.cmd install --prefix client

author: Invoice Fraud Detection Team
